positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Served as on-call SRE for the core infrastructure team, responsible for routing in Cisco’s enterprise network.

Worked on full application stack of an internal Cisco IT service used by SREs during on-call duty. The service offers a network inventory and real time topology data for Cisco’s corporate network. I was responsible for building SSH polling in Go, REST API services in Node.js, and frontend web UIs in React.js.

Worked on network automation platform that pushes configuration templates via NSO and Ansible. I was responsible for writing integrations with Service Now to retrieve network data, CyberArk to pull credentials for workflows, and DNS to verify IP addresses applied in the config.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked on backend systems of Secure Cloud Interconnect. This service allowed Cisco IT to securely connect to AWS and Google Cloud Services. I was responsible for writing APIs in Python to retrieve account info from MongoDB to be displayed on a React.js frontend.and develop backend for the service’s web UI.

positions.title: Electrical Engineer Intern
positions.description: Assisted in designing and fabricating the wiring harness that connected all electrical systems for the formula racecar. My responsibilities included organizing the connections into spreadsheets, tracing out the cables in CAD, integrating with powertrain team, and assembling the harness.
